scenario.summary: Attackers utilize mobile-first strategies including smishing and 'EvilTokens' device code phishing to bypass multi-factor authentication and gain unauthorized access to corporate accounts. Once access is established, the compromised identities are used to perform reconnaissance and data collection within Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments.

meta.rationale: The hunt first scopes the estate to identify devices with Zimperium or other MTD software. If no mobile management software is present, the hunt still proceeds across the entire fleet using the DNS phishing lead as the primary discovery mechanism.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is targeting employees with mobile phishing links (smishing) that lure them into performing Entra ID device-code authentication, allowing the attacker to hijack cloud sessions from compromised or unmanaged mobile devices.

hunt.name: Mobile Ingress and Device Code Hijacking
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the early stages of mobile-centric intrusions by correlating phishing ingress signals with subsequent authentication anomalies. It starts by identifying hosts running mobile management software, then hunts for resolutions to known phishing and EvilTokens infrastructure. A gate assessments the lead before fan-out queries examine device-code authentication flows and Zimperium-style device risk detections (like rooting or jailbreaking) side-by-side. An agent weighs the combined evidence to identify successful session theft before a revocation action stops the attack.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%zimperium%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%zimperium%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%mobile%')

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookups, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{phishing_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname

config.expected_signal: Any resolution of a matched domain is a high-priority lead. Silence proves no matched domains were resolved via monitored resolvers.
